story: Seraphina is chosen by the king to defeat a dragon named Gorthak that threatens the kingdom. As she journeys forward, she solves riddles and faces magical challenges. Along the way, she gains a Moonstone and a magical compass that guide her path. When she finally meets the dragon, she uses courage and wisdom instead of fear. In the end, she restores peace and proves that true strength comes from both bravery and understanding.
